quotes.author: Scott Fricker
quotes.text: Last night was such a fun Sky Adventure! OMG, the whole event was so much fun , from start to finish ! Dennis, Richard, Jeff and crew was fantastic! The spectacular views and talking to people on the ground and skimming the the tops, over small lakes and country side and see deer scamper away! Two balloons filled with friends was so much fun! I cant say enough about the plans, crew and flight! Great way to celebrate Julie’s 60th Birthday!! The memory will live for ever !! Thanks Sky Adventure for truly a fantastic evening !!

quotes.author: Nancy Cole
quotes.text: I’m trying to reach as many people as possible to let them know about this amazing company! Maybe I should say family! The weather kept fighting us, but Dennis worked with me on new dates five different times. This was on my husband’s bucket list. Andy made it a special three generations night. Although I didn’t fly, I still felt like a part of it. It was great to spend time with the whole Sky Adventure family after. They are the company you want to trust this experience to. Thanks Dennis, Andy and all the rest of the crew!

quotes.author: Mike Langlois
quotes.text: One thing on my bucket list was to take my family on a hot air balloon ride. Sky Adventures let me check that off my list. Dennis was our pilot and he was excellent and very professional along with the rest of his staff. We couldn’t go on our first scheduled appointment but Dennis made it work another time. The ride was so smooth and visually beautiful. There was still some color on the trees in late October. We never felt unsafe. My family and I loved it and would do it again. We highly recommend Sky Adventures!!

quotes.author: Susie
quotes.text: Oh my gosh! What a perfect evening for our group. Bucket list✔️ Dennis, Jeff and family were beyond accommodating, friendly, funny yet extremely detail oriented. The whole process was extremely fascinating to watch. We had no idea all the details and work that went in to preparing for the launch and the take down afterwards. I can’t recommend this experience enough. Looking at our world from an entirely different perspective is a glorious gift! Thank you Sky Adventures for an unforgettable memory!

quotes.author: Carol Christiansen
quotes.text: It has been over 10 years since my husband and I took our ride with Sky Adventures. Every time I look back at our pictures from that day, I have been reminded of the feelings of awe and amazement we both remember — almost like it was yesterday. “Stunning” doesn’t even begin to describe our experience. We went in the fall, so viewing the fall colors from above was a wonderful new perspective. Thank you, Sky Adventures, for a truly once in a lifetime day!

quotes.author: Rhoda Littles
quotes.text: This was one of my Birthday Bucket List experiences for my Spectacular 65th Birthday and it was a totally awesome adventure. I felt so relaxed as I was taking everything in while enjoying the sunrise and warm breeze of the morning air as we floated across the breathtaking scenery. Big “shout out” to the professional and friendly Sky Adventures staff for being a part of my 65th Birthday Bucket List that added an awesomely happy memory !!
